headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Our govt, Centre working together for development, says Revanth.
Telangana Ethics Committee defers decision on Kaushik Reddy, seeks reply by October 7.
Karnataka to host first Urdu Habba at Vidhana Soudha on Nov 9.
23 years after invasion, U.S. leaves Iraq; stays in Iran.
bullets_ur: Hukumat aur Centre taraqqi ke liye mil kar kaam kar rahe hain, Revanth ka kehna hai.
Telangana Ethics Committee ne Kaushik Reddy par faisla 7 October tak multawi kar diya, jawab talab.
Karnataka mein pehla Urdu Habba 9 November ko Vidhana Soudha mein muntaqil hoga.
23 saal baad hamlay ke, US Iraq se nikal gaya; Iran mein thehra raha.
